annotations.title: Get CBP Use of Force Totals

description: National yearly totals from CBP's own use-of-force and assault files in the Border Force Register (FY2021 on; the current fiscal year is labelled partial): use-of-force incidents by force type (vehicle and vessel force included), officers/agents using force and officers/agents assaulted (both counted per incident), and assault incidents, each year with the CBP file and date it comes from. With fiscal_year, adds that year's revision log entries, each labelled as published on its date: revisions are as-published versions of CBP's files, not corrections and not evidence of misconduct. Also returns the status of DHS's department-wide use-of-force tables, the series with no newer edition (including ICE's count in DHS's table), and DHS's tables beside CBP's files with the definitions note; the two use different definitions and are never added or merged. No rates and no causation.

fiscal_year.description: Optional federal fiscal year from 2021; when set, returns that year and its revision log entries as published on each date.
